description: Ministry of Mahaweli Development and Environment - for inspection- Environment Impact Assessment  Report of Port of Kankasanturai Jaffana District
categorisation: This gazette notification is a legal/regulatory matter concerning environmental impact assessment procedures under the Coast Conservation and Coastal Resource Management Act. It announces the public availability of an EIA report for a port rehabilitation project as required by specific legislation, making it a regulatory compliance notice rather than a government personnel, organizational, land, commercial, or other specialized category.
